description: Candidate port of nera-data-layer internal_dead_code at 2b1504adc4291daaf080b2e932962b134da1a69a.

stages.name: raw_bases
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_base_names UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_base_expressions

stages.name: raw_parameter_annotations
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_typed_annotations UNION ALL SELECT * FROM raw_typed_default_annotations

stages.name: inventory
stages.query:
SELECT *, module || '::' || CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN name ELSE class_name || '.' || name END AS id,
 module || '.' || CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN name ELSE class_name || '.' || name END AS fqname
 FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,name,class_name,return_annotation,class_start,body_start, replace(rx_replace(__path, '/__init__\.py$|\.py$', ''), '/', '.') AS module, CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN 'function' ELSE 'method' END AS kind FROM raw_functions
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,name,NULL,NULL,NULL,body_start,replace(rx_replace(__path, '/__init__\.py$|\.py$', ''), '/', '.'),'class' FROM raw_classes)

stages.name: declarations
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY __start DESC) AS selected FROM inventory) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: decorators
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_decorators

stages.name: annotation_names
stages.query:
SELECT d.id AS symbol,a.name FROM raw_return_annotations a JOIN declarations d ON d.__path=a.__path AND d.__start=a.owner
 UNION SELECT d.id,a.name FROM raw_parameter_annotations a JOIN declarations d ON d.__path=a.__path AND d.__start=a.owner
 WHERE d.class_name IS NULL OR a.parameter_name NOT IN ('self','cls')

stages.name: imports
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE
 tokens(path,ordinal,top,base,item,rest) AS (
 SELECT __path,__start,top,base,'',rx_replace(items,'#[^\n]*','') || ',' FROM raw_imports
 UNION ALL SELECT path,ordinal,top,base,trim(substr(rest,1,instr(rest,',')-1),' ()' || char(10) || char(13)),substr(rest,instr(rest,',')+1) FROM tokens WHERE rest<>''),
 parts AS (SELECT *,rx_extract(item,'^(\S+)',1) AS original, rx_extract(item,'\s+as\s+(\S+)$',1) AS alias,
 replace(rx_replace(path,'/__init__\.py$|\.py$',''),'/','.') AS module FROM tokens WHERE item<>''),
 relative(path,ordinal,top,base,original,alias,module,prefix,remaining) AS (
 SELECT path,ordinal,top,base,original,alias,module,CASE WHEN path LIKE '%/__init__.py' THEN module ELSE rx_replace(module,'\.?[^.]+$','') END,
 coalesce(length(base)-length(ltrim(base,'.'))-1,-1) FROM parts
 UNION ALL SELECT path,ordinal,top,base,original,alias,module,rx_replace(prefix,'\.?[^.]+$',''),remaining-1 FROM relative WHERE remaining>0),
 resolved AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN base IS NULL THEN original WHEN base NOT LIKE '.%' THEN base || '.' || original
 ELSE CASE WHEN prefix='' THEN '' ELSE prefix || '.' END || CASE WHEN ltrim(base,'.')='' THEN '' ELSE ltrim(base,'.') || '.' END || original END AS target,
 coalesce(alias,CASE WHEN base IS NULL THEN rx_extract(original,'^[^.]+',0) ELSE original END) AS name FROM relative WHERE remaining<=0)
 SELECT path,ordinal,top,module,name,target,CASE WHEN base IS NULL THEN 'module' ELSE 'symbol' END AS kind
 FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY module,name,base IS NULL ORDER BY ordinal DESC) AS selected FROM resolved WHERE original<>'*') WHERE selected=1

stages.name: resolved_names
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE names(fqname,symbol) AS (
 SELECT fqname,id FROM declarations UNION
 SELECT i.module || '.' || i.name,n.symbol FROM names n CROSS JOIN imports i ON i.target=n.fqname
 WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM declarations d WHERE d.fqname=i.module || '.' || i.name))
 SELECT * FROM names

stages.name: base_edges
stages.query:
SELECT d.id AS owner,b.id AS base,r.__start AS ordinal FROM raw_bases r JOIN declarations d ON d.__path=r.__path AND d.__start=r.owner
 JOIN declarations b ON b.kind='class' AND b.id=coalesce(
 (SELECT c.id FROM imports i JOIN declarations c ON c.fqname=i.target AND c.kind='class'
 WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND i.module=d.module AND i.name=trim(rx_replace(rx_replace(r.name,'(?s)\[.*$',''),'^.*\.','')) LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT c.id FROM declarations c WHERE c.module=d.module AND c.kind='class' AND c.name=trim(rx_replace(rx_replace(r.name,'(?s)\[.*$',''),'^.*\.','')) LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT min(c.id) FROM declarations c WHERE c.kind='class' AND c.name=trim(rx_replace(rx_replace(r.name,'(?s)\[.*$',''),'^.*\.','')) HAVING count(*)=1))

stages.name: hierarchy
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE walk(owner,base,depth,route,seen) AS (
 SELECT id,id,0,'',',' || id || ',' FROM declarations WHERE kind='class' UNION ALL
 SELECT w.owner,e.base,w.depth+1,w.route || printf('%012d.',e.ordinal),w.seen || e.base || ',' FROM walk w JOIN base_edges e ON e.owner=w.base WHERE instr(w.seen,',' || e.base || ',')=0)
 SELECT owner,base,depth,route FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY owner,base ORDER BY depth,route) AS selected FROM walk) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: public_methods
stages.query:
SELECT owner,name,symbol FROM (
 SELECT h.owner,d.name,d.id AS symbol,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY h.owner,d.name ORDER BY h.depth,h.route) AS selected
 FROM hierarchy h JOIN declarations c ON c.id=h.base JOIN declarations d ON d.module=c.module AND d.class_name=c.name
 WHERE d.kind='method' AND substr(d.name,1,1)<>'_' AND d.name NOT IN ('__aenter__','__aexit__','__enter__','__exit__','__init__','__repr__','__str__','authorize_internal_access','disable_thread_affinity_checks','get_thread_checks_disabled','set_disable_thread_checks','validate_legacy_delegates','versioned_read','versioned_write')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'property$|\.setter$|\.deleter$'))) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: all_names
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_all_names

stages.name: explicit_exports
stages.query: SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY __path ORDER BY __start) AS selected FROM raw_all

stages.name: export_names
stages.query:
SELECT path,module,name,target FROM imports WHERE top IS NOT NULL AND kind='symbol' AND rx_matches(path,'^data_layer/[^/]+\.py$')
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,module,name,fqname FROM declarations WHERE class_name IS NULL AND rx_matches(__path,'^data_layer/[^/]+\.py$')

stages.name: exported_roots
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT e.path,e.module AS export_module,e.name AS export_name,n.symbol FROM export_names e JOIN resolved_names n ON n.fqname=e.target
 LEFT JOIN explicit_exports a ON a.__path=e.path AND a.selected=1
 WHERE substr(e.name,1,1)<>'_' AND (a.__path IS NULL OR (a.array IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM all_names v WHERE v.__path=e.path AND v.owner=a.__start AND v.name=e.name)))

stages.name: bases
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_bases

stages.name: dead_traits
stages.query:
SELECT d.*,rx_replace(d.name,'_(?:async|lazy)$','') AS base_name,CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE module || '::' || class_name END AS class_id,
 CASE WHEN kind='class' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ABC')>0)
 ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'abstractmethod$')) END AS abstract,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'property$|\.setter$|\.deleter$')) AS property,
 rx_matches(name,'^__.*__$') OR name IN ('main','pytest_configure','pytest_collection_modifyitems') OR
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'validator$|overload$')) AS implicit,
 rx_matches(name,'Protocol$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'Protocol')>0) AS protocol,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'Protocol')>0) AS structural_protocol
 FROM declarations d

stages.name: class_names
stages.query:
SELECT r.module,r.name,coalesce(
 (SELECT c.id FROM imports i JOIN resolved_names n ON n.fqname=i.target JOIN declarations c ON c.id=n.symbol AND c.kind='class' WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND i.module=r.module AND i.name=r.name LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT c.id FROM declarations c WHERE c.kind='class' AND c.module=r.module AND c.name=r.name LIMIT 1)) AS target
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d.module,a.name FROM annotation_names a JOIN declarations d ON d.id=a.symbol) r

stages.name: module_names
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT replace(rx_replace(__path, '/__init__\.py$|\.py$', ''), '/', '.') AS module,name FROM (SELECT __path,name FROM raw_control_names
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,name FROM raw_nested_names UNION ALL SELECT __path,name FROM raw_class_body_names)

stages.name: imported_modules
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE modules(module) AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN kind='module' THEN target ELSE rx_replace(target,'\.?[^.]+$','') END FROM imports
 UNION SELECT rx_replace(module,'\.?[^.]+$','') FROM modules WHERE instr(module,'.')>0)
 SELECT DISTINCT module FROM modules WHERE module<>''

cases.true: SELECT symbol FROM exported_roots UNION SELECT p.symbol FROM public_methods p JOIN exported_roots r ON r.symbol=p.owner UNION SELECT '@module:' || module FROM imported_modules
cases.false: SELECT symbol FROM exported_roots UNION SELECT p.symbol FROM public_methods p JOIN exported_roots r ON r.symbol=p.owner UNION SELECT '@module:' || module FROM imported_modules UNION SELECT n.symbol FROM raw_dynamic_imports d JOIN resolved_names n ON n.fqname=rx_extract(d.entry,'(?:\bimport_module|\bload_python_module|\bimportlib\.import_module)\(\s*[''\"](?P<module>[^''\"]+)[''\"]\s*\)\.(?P<attr>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)',1) || '.' || rx_extract(d.entry,'(?:\bimport_module|\bload_python_module|\bimportlib\.import_module)\(\s*[''\"](?P<module>[^''\"]+)[''\"]\s*\)\.(?P<attr>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)',2)

stages.name: reach_edges
stages.query:
SELECT s.id AS source,t.id AS target FROM reference_edges e
 JOIN declarations s ON s.__path=e.__path AND s.__start=e.__start JOIN declarations t ON t.__path=e.target_path AND t.__start=e.target_start
 UNION SELECT owner,symbol FROM public_methods
 UNION SELECT h.owner,m.id FROM hierarchy h JOIN declarations c ON c.id=h.base JOIN declarations m ON m.module=c.module AND m.class_name=c.name
 WHERE m.name IN ('__new__','__init__','__init_subclass__','__post_init__','__set_name__','__class_getitem__')
 UNION SELECT owner,base FROM base_edges UNION SELECT base,owner FROM base_edges
 UNION SELECT d.id,s.id FROM dead_traits d CROSS JOIN declarations s ON s.module=d.module
 AND s.name IN (d.base_name,d.base_name || '_async',d.base_name || '_lazy') AND s.id<>d.id WHERE d.kind='function'
 UNION SELECT d.id,s.id FROM dead_traits d CROSS JOIN declarations s ON s.id IN
 (d.class_id || '.' || d.base_name,d.class_id || '.' || d.base_name || '_async',d.class_id || '.' || d.base_name || '_lazy') AND s.id<>d.id WHERE d.kind='method'
 UNION SELECT a.symbol,c.target FROM annotation_names a JOIN declarations d ON d.id=a.symbol JOIN class_names c ON c.module=d.module AND c.name=a.name WHERE c.target IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT d.id,'@module:' || d.module FROM declarations d
 UNION SELECT '@module:' || n.module,d.id FROM module_names n JOIN declarations d ON d.module=n.module AND d.name=n.name
 UNION SELECT '@module:' || n.module,d.id FROM module_names n JOIN imports i ON i.module=n.module AND i.name=n.name AND i.kind='symbol' JOIN declarations d ON d.fqname=i.target
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM declarations local WHERE local.module=n.module AND local.name=n.name)
 UNION SELECT m.id,other.id FROM dead_traits m JOIN dead_traits c ON c.id=m.class_id AND c.structural_protocol
 JOIN dead_traits other ON other.kind='method' AND other.name=m.name AND other.class_id<>m.class_id

stages.name: reachable
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE flow(node,dispatch) AS (
 SELECT symbol,NULL FROM dead_roots
 UNION SELECT e.target,NULL FROM flow f JOIN reach_edges e ON e.source=f.node WHERE f.dispatch IS NULL
 UNION SELECT b.owner,f.node FROM flow f JOIN dead_traits m ON m.id=f.node JOIN base_edges b ON b.base=m.class_id WHERE f.dispatch IS NULL AND m.kind='method'
 UNION SELECT b.owner,f.dispatch FROM flow f JOIN base_edges b ON b.base=f.node WHERE f.dispatch IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT b.base,f.dispatch FROM flow f JOIN base_edges b ON b.owner=f.node JOIN dead_traits original ON original.id=f.dispatch WHERE f.dispatch IS NOT NULL AND b.base<>original.class_id
 UNION SELECT m.id,NULL FROM flow f JOIN dead_traits original ON original.id=f.dispatch JOIN declarations c ON c.id=f.node JOIN dead_traits m ON m.module=c.module AND m.class_name=c.name AND m.name=original.name WHERE f.dispatch IS NOT NULL)
 SELECT DISTINCT node AS symbol FROM flow WHERE dispatch IS NULL

stages.name: annotation_reachable
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE unique_classes(name,target) AS (SELECT name,min(id) FROM declarations WHERE kind='class' GROUP BY name HAVING count(*)=1),
 annotated(symbol) AS (SELECT symbol FROM reachable UNION SELECT c.target FROM annotated r JOIN annotation_names a ON a.symbol=r.symbol JOIN unique_classes c ON c.name=a.name)
 SELECT symbol FROM annotated

stages.name: high_confidence
stages.query:
SELECT d.* FROM dead_traits d
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM annotation_reachable r WHERE r.symbol=d.id)
 AND NOT rx_matches(d.module,'^(?:api|data_layer)\.') AND NOT d.implicit
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM imports i WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND i.target=d.fqname)
 AND NOT (d.kind='class' AND d.protocol)
 AND NOT (d.kind<>'class' AND (d.abstract OR d.property OR instr(d.name,'_lower_')=1 OR instr(lower(d.name),'register')>0
   OR rx_matches(d.name,'^_create_.*_(?:connection|validator|factory)$')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dead_traits c WHERE c.id=d.class_id AND c.protocol)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hierarchy h JOIN dead_traits c ON c.id=h.base JOIN dead_traits m ON m.module=c.module AND m.class_name=c.name AND m.name=d.name AND m.abstract WHERE h.owner=d.class_id AND h.depth>0)))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hierarchy h JOIN dead_traits b ON b.id=h.base JOIN annotation_reachable r ON r.symbol=b.id
   WHERE h.owner=CASE WHEN d.kind='class' THEN d.id ELSE d.class_id END AND h.depth>0 AND
   (b.abstract OR (instr(b.name,'ABC')>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM base_edges e WHERE e.owner=h.owner AND e.base=b.id))))

cases.true:
SELECT __path AS path,__start AS start_byte,__end AS end_byte,id AS symbol,category FROM (SELECT d.*, 'high_confidence_functions' AS category FROM high_confidence d WHERE kind<>'class'
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_intents' FROM high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND (rx_matches(d.name,'Intent$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ServerPlanStep')>0))
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_grammar_classes' FROM high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND (NOT d.protocol AND (instr(d.__path,'/l2100_sql_grammar/')>0 OR rx_matches(d.name,'Grammar$|^Sql') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(b.name,'Sql|Grammar'))))
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_other_classes' FROM high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND NOT (rx_matches(d.name,'Intent$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ServerPlanStep')>0)) AND NOT (NOT d.protocol AND (instr(d.__path,'/l2100_sql_grammar/')>0 OR rx_matches(d.name,'Grammar$|^Sql') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(b.name,'Sql|Grammar')))))

 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_grammar_classes' FROM high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND (NOT d.protocol AND (instr(d.__path,'/l2100_sql_grammar/')>0 OR rx_matches(d.name,'Grammar$|^Sql') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(b.name,'Sql|Grammar'))))
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_other_classes' FROM high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND NOT (rx_matches(d.name,'Intent$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ServerPlanStep')>0)) AND NOT (NOT d.protocol AND (instr(d.__path,'/l2100_sql_grammar/')>0 OR rx_matches(d.name,'Grammar$|^Sql') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(b.name,'Sql|Grammar'))))) WHERE instr(__path,'impl/browser/')<>1
